label: canon-dams-family-n3
_why: PROD-LIKE BATCH of the ruled dam rules (user, 2026-09-28: a quantitative analysis of how many dams get built, how many stall (queued, not built for over a year, blocking another candidate builder or not) and how many are wasted (partially built then abandoned: investment rights lost / subject status lost / other)). The book: config/mod_config.canon-dams-family.json = the canon canon-dams + dams.rules family + dams.log_levels - construction rights = the owner, its overlord chain, or investment rights in the owner or any of that chain; a survey inside the owners top-overlord family opens the dam to the whole family, an outsider survey to itself; a 12-month block on others surveys from the start of one (lifted if it is abandoned); no survey while a level is queued; no claim; the AI takes the survey decision itself, gated on spare bureaucracy >= cost with a 30-day take cooldown for the AI only; no driver. Probed by p29 (session 20260928_202538). LAUNCH ONLY ON THE USERS EXPLICIT GO-AHEAD.
_comparison: canon-dams-engine-n5 (20260928_000616, the canon rules: 3 intact / 1 runoff / 1 stall, 17-49 levels per run, 4 abandoned constructions) and the pinned vanilla n=16 (20260821_131149)
_instrument: the canon telemetry + PMR_DAM debug.log lines (survey_*, family_survey, built / complete, bur_year, and the MONTHLY probe_lvl / probe_q level log) + QUARTERLY save summaries (who queued which dam and its points left, per quarter)
_stop_rule: fixed n=3: all three play to 1936, no stop watcher
_cost: 3 runs x 1836 -> 1936, about 2.5-3 hours each (quarterly saves add several minutes)
